name: Blur

whyMatters.en: Colchester/London Britpop band formed in 1988. Parklife (1994) and The Great Escape (1995) put observational English pop on UK charts; later albums 13 and Think Tank moved toward art-rock and electronic textures.
whyMatters.zh: 科尔切斯特/伦敦 Britpop 乐队，1988 年成立。《Parklife》（1994）与《The Great Escape》（1995）以观察式英式流行进入英国榜；后期专辑《13》《Think Tank》转向 art-rock 与电子音色。

note.en: Title track from Parklife; spoken-sung verses, brass color, jaunty chord pattern.
note.zh: 《Parklife》标题曲；说唱式主歌、铜管色彩、轻快和弦进行。

note.en: Two-minute loud/quiet single from Blur; Coxon crunch guitar, Albarn “woo-hoo” hook; US radio hit.
note.zh: 出自《Blur》的两分钟强弱单曲；Coxon 失真吉他、Albarn 的 woo-hoo 钩子；打进美国电台。

note.en: Think Tank era without Coxon; electronic and guest textures around Albarn’s vocal.
note.zh: 无 Coxon 的 Think Tank 时期；电子与客座音色环绕 Albarn 人声。

interviewQuotes.text: If you wake up in the morning and you feel like a pop star, then you're a pop star.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Damon Albarn

interviewQuotes.text: I wanted the guitars to sound like they were falling apart.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Graham Coxon

lyricQuotes: Girls who are boys who like boys to be girls

shortBio.en: Albarn / Coxon Britpop, 1988–. Parklife and Song 2 are core references; Think Tank is the Coxon-less chapter.
shortBio.zh: Albarn / Coxon 的 Britpop，1988 年至今。《Parklife》与《Song 2》是主要参照；《Think Tank》是无 Coxon 时期。

body.en:
Blur formed in Colchester in 1988. Leisure (1991) and Modern Life Is Rubbish (1993) set the early UK indie base. Parklife (1994) and The Great Escape (1995) reached UK #1 and were widely covered against Oasis in the mid-90s chart press.

Blur (1997) includes Song 2, a short loud/quiet track that charted in the US. Coxon’s guitar—noise, feedback, short chops—marks the four-piece sound through 13 (1999). He left before Think Tank (2003); later reunions restore the classic lineup. Albarn also formed Gorillaz outside this band.
body.zh:
Blur 于 1988 年在科尔切斯特成立。《Leisure》（1991）与《Modern Life Is Rubbish》（1993）建立早期英国 indie 基础。《Parklife》（1994）与《The Great Escape》（1995）登上英国榜冠军，并在 90 年代中期媒体上常与 Oasis 对照报道。

《Blur》（1997）含《Song 2》，短强弱单曲，进入美国榜。Coxon 的吉他——噪声、反馈、短切分——贯穿四人组至《13》（1999）。他在《Think Tank》（2003）前离队；后期重聚恢复经典阵容。Albarn 另组建 Gorillaz。

body.en:
Parklife (1994) centers on English everyday detail, character voices, and clear verse/chorus shapes. Albarn writes roles; Coxon plays noise and short guitar figures rather than long solos.

The mid-90s UK press paired Blur with Oasis on the charts. Arrangement and lyric method are the musical facts.
body.zh:
《Parklife》（1994）以英式日常细节、角色人声和清楚的主副歌结构为主。Albarn 写角色；Coxon 用噪声与短句吉他，少做长 solo。

90 年代中期英国媒体常把 Blur 与 Oasis 放在榜单对照中。编曲与歌词写法是音乐事实。

title.zh: 经典四人组与 Think Tank

body.en:
Damon Albarn, Graham Coxon, Alex James, and Dave Rowntree are the best-known lineup from Modern Life Is Rubbish through 13.

Coxon left before Think Tank (2003). Electronic parts and guests covered the guitar role. Reunions from 2009 onward restore the four-piece.
body.zh:
Damon Albarn、Graham Coxon、Alex James 与 Dave Rowntree 是从《Modern Life Is Rubbish》到《13》最熟悉的阵容。

Coxon 在《Think Tank》（2003）前离队。电子音色与客座乐手填补吉他。2009 年起的重聚恢复四人组。

body.en:
Girls & Boys opens the Parklife cycle with disco-leaning bass and an observational chorus. The title track Parklife uses spoken-sung verses and brass.

Both singles are central to the 1994 UK chart run.
body.zh:
《Girls & Boys》以偏迪斯科的贝斯与观察式副歌打开《Parklife》周期。标题曲《Parklife》用说唱式主歌与铜管。

两首单曲都是 1994 年英国榜单期的核心曲目。

body.en:
Song 2 (1997) is about two minutes: quiet verse, loud chorus, Coxon distortion, Albarn’s woo-hoo hook. It became the band’s main US radio entry.

Coffee & TV on 13 (1999) shows Coxon taking a melodic lead vocal.
body.zh:
《Song 2》（1997）约两分钟：安静主歌、大声副歌、Coxon 失真、Albarn 的 woo-hoo 钩子。成为乐队进入美国电台的主要单曲。

《13》（1999）上的《Coffee & TV》由 Coxon 主唱旋律声部。

title.zh: Albarn 与 Coxon 的分工

body.en:
Albarn’s interviews stress character and pop presentation. Coxon has described wanting guitars that sound unstable—noise and texture over flashy solos.

Outside Blur, Albarn developed Gorillaz as a separate project.
body.zh:
Albarn 的访谈强调角色与流行呈现。Coxon 曾说希望吉他听起来不稳定——噪声与音色优先于炫技 solo。

在 Blur 之外，Albarn 另做 Gorillaz。

title.zh: 后来英国 indie 的引用

body.en:
Later UK indie bands often cite Coxon’s guitar vocabulary and Albarn’s character-led lyrics. Arctic Monkeys are among acts linked to observational songwriting habits.

Think Tank remains the main electronic-leaning Blur album after Coxon’s exit.
body.zh:
后来的英国 indie 乐队常引用 Coxon 的吉他写法与 Albarn 的角色歌词。Arctic Monkeys 等与观察式写歌习惯有关联。

《Think Tank》仍是 Coxon 离队后最主要的偏电子专辑。

note.en: Modern Life Is Rubbish through 13; Coxon on guitar throughout.
note.zh: 《Modern Life Is Rubbish》至《13》；全程 Coxon 吉他。

note.en: Coxon exits; Think Tank leans electronic and art-rock.
note.zh: Coxon 离队；《Think Tank》偏电子与 art-rock。

note.en: Key 1994 single; observational English pop on UK radio.
note.zh: 1994 年重要单曲；观察式英式流行进入英国电台。

note.en: Character pop and Coxon guitar texture across Britpop and later art-rock records.
note.zh: 角色流行与 Coxon 吉他音色，贯穿 Britpop 与后期 art-rock 录音。
